::: {#rem-iff-template}
#### The shape of an "if and only if" proof

A proof of "$P$ if and only if $Q$" has two parts:

> | ($\Rightarrow$) Suppose $P$.
> | $\vdots$
> | Therefore $Q$.
> |
> | ($\Leftarrow$) Suppose $Q$.
> | $\vdots$
> | Therefore $P$.

Each part is a proof of a conditional,
so each can be a direct proof (@def-direct-proof),
a proof by contrapositive (@def-proof-by-contrapositive),
or a proof by contradiction (@def-proof-by-contradiction),
and the two parts need not use the same method.

:::
